Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-rays demonstrate radiolucent streaks of air outlining the mediastinal structures (red arrows) and tracking into the soft tissues of the neck (yellow arrowheads), which are classic signs of pneumomediastinum and subcutaneous emphysema. This presentation, combined with a history of strong coughing attacks, is characteristic of spontaneous pneumomediastinum caused by alveolar rupture due to increased intrathoracic pressure.
